system_prompt:
You are participating in a research study on how language models respond to
choice questions. There is no correct answer and no answer is more helpful
than any other. Answer with a single JSON object and no other text.

models.notes: Model family 1. Cheap, widely available, stable pinned ID.

preference_items.option_a: work through a multi-step mathematical reasoning problem
preference_items.option_b: write a condensed summary of a long technical document
preference_items.rationale: Contrasts symbolic/deductive processing against compression of prose.
known_possible_confounds: Assistant training may over-represent summarization as a canonical task.

preference_items.option_a: track down the cause of a defect in a piece of code that fails
preference_items.option_b: walk through how a piece of code that already works behaves
preference_items.rationale: Contrasts diagnostic search with expository explanation on shared content.
known_possible_confounds: Debugging implies an external failure state that may cue urgency.
